NIA chargesheets 13 in Pakistan-linked espionage case

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has filed a chargesheet against 13 individuals in connection with a Pakistan-linked espionage racket. The accused allegedly used local SIM cards to spy for a hostile nation, sending geo-tagged photos and videos. The chargesheet was filed before the Special NIA Court in Lucknow.
